title: Locally Lipschitz images of null and of σ-finite measurable sets (parent P3)
statement: For all P, Q, n, every U ⊆ ℝ^P and every f : ℝ^P → ℝ^Q locally Lipschitz on U: (i) if Z ⊆ U and Hⁿ(Z) = 0 then Hⁿ(f(Z)) = 0; (ii) if A ⊆ U is Hⁿ-null-measurable and Hⁿ⌞A is σ-finite then f(A) is Hⁿ-null-measurable in ℝ^Q.
lean_statement: ∀ (P Q n : ℕ) (U : Set (Eucl P)) (f : Eucl P → Eucl Q), LocallyLipschitzOn U f → (∀ Z ⊆ U, (μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)) Z = 0 → (μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl Q)) (f '' Z) = 0) ∧ ∀ A ⊆ U, NullMeasurableSet A (μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)) → SigmaFinite ((μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl P)).restrict A) → NullMeasurableSet (f '' A) (μHE[n] : Measure (Eucl Q))
